data.title: Bloom Energy slides 11% after quarterly results
data.description:
Shares of Bloom Energy (BE), which designs, manufactures, and installs modular solid-oxide fuel-cell systems for onsite electricity generation, tumbled more than 11% on Friday. This came after the company reported record quarterly results that still failed to satisfy elevated market expectations.

data.title: Semiconductors will rally by the end of the year, says SA analyst
data.description:
Semiconductors should be headed towards positive territory into the end of the year, said Seeking Alpha analyst Alex King of Cestrian Capital Research.

While semiconductors (SOXX), (SMH) ended higher this week, the group saw big losses this week amid a continued technology selloff due to fears around elevated AI expenditures.

The VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH) ended up 0.7% on Friday but lost 4.56% this week. Similarly, the iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX) closed up 0.5% but declined almost 6% this week.

“I think semiconductors and everything else is headed up into year-end. Possibly without those who were shaken out this week,” King said.

On the other hand, the Dow (DJI) ended higher this week, adding 0.4% to weekly gains, even when the index lost 1.2% on Friday.

Small caps (IWM) also saw a week of gains, as well as defense stocks (ITA), (ARKX), U.S. government bonds (US10Y), (US30Y), (US2Y), and even biotech (XBI), (BBH), King noted.

Bitcoin (BTC-USD) declined 0.6% in the past five days and was flat on Friday.

“The crypto boogeyman was flat. Despite which there is a caterwaul of crying in the casino, which can only be because people are far too concentrated in the same high-beta semiconductor and component stocks,” King said.

data.title: Aberdeen Multi-Market Income Fund announces 1-for-4 reverse stock split
data.description:
• Aberdeen Multi-Market Income Fund (MMT) said on Friday that its board approved a 1-for-4 reverse stock split of the fund's issued and outstanding common shares, effective November 9, 2026.

  • The board approved the reverse stock split to increase the fund's per-share market price that could help reduce certain trading and administrative frictions associated with lower-priced securities, increase the fund's suitability for certain investment platforms and intermediary programs, and better align the fund's share price with industry trading conventions, the company said.

  • No fractional shares will be issued.

  • Source: Press Release

DoE authorizes 400K-barrel emergency SPR release for Phillips 66 Lake Charles refinery
data.description:
The U.S. Department of Energy said Friday it authorized an emergency release of up to 400K barrels of crude oil from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve to address a supply disruption affecting Phillips 66's (PSX) Lake Charles refinery in Louisiana.

"The supply will help offset temporary disruptions affecting crude oil deliveries to the refinery and support continued production of transportation fuels serving Louisiana and surrounding markets," the DoE said, without specifying the nature of the disruption at the 264K bbl/day refinery.

Phillips 66 (PSX) confirmed it will receive crude from the SPR but did not comment on refinery operations or commercial activity except to say that "we do not anticipate impacts to Lake Charles ⁠operations."

Like most of the recent program of releases from the reserve, the DoE said it authorized release as an exchange, meaning Phillips 66 (PSX) must return the same amount of oil it receives, along with additional barrels as a premium for the loan.

DoE data this week showed supplies in the reserve now total 282.7M barrels, its lowest level since October 1982, following drawdowns during the U.S.-Iran war and, earlier, Russia's invasion of Ukraine.

data.title: OPay to offer 16M American depositary shares in IPO at $19-$21 apiece
data.description:
OPay Digital Services (OPAY) has amended the F-1 registration statement related to its IPO to offer 16M American depositary shares at a price range of $19 to $21.

Each ADS represents ten ordinary shares of par value of $0.000004 each.

The Nigeria-focused SoftBank (SFTBY) (SFTBF) backed company continues to target an NYSE listing under the ticker symbol 'OPAY'.

Citigroup (C), B. Riley Securities, Deutsche Bank (DB), Standard Bank, Needham & Company, and CICC are the underwriters.

data.title: CrowdStrike climbs 8%, adding to gains seen earlier in the week
data.description:
Shares of CrowdStrike Holdings (CRWD), the AI-native cybersecurity platform company, rose just over 8% on Friday. The stock closed at $257.57, up $19.63 on the session.

The stock had climbed 5% on Wednesday before ticking down fractionally during Thursday's session. CRWD had come off its highs during October after a sharp rise over the previous several months. 

Share are up about 120% so far in 2026.

data.title: Phathom falls as FDA sued over refusal to accept ANDA for generic Voquezna
data.description:
• Phathom Pharmaceuticals (PHAT) closed Friday down 18% after an Indian pharma company sued the US FDA for refusing to accept an abbreviated new drug application for a generic version of the former's Voquezna (vonoprazan).
  • In June 2025, the agency granted Phathom’s December 2024 Citizen Petition by recognizing 10 years of new chemical exclusivity for Voquezna through May 3, 2032. 
  • In its complaint filed with the US District Court for the District of Columbia, BDR Pharmaceuticals International Pvt. Ltd. argues that the FDA improperly applied the GAIN Act to extend Voquezna's exclusivity.
